market.summary: GIFT Nifty points to a slightly lower start (about 40-70 points under Thursday's levels) after Nifty closed +0.25% at 25,884.50. Asia is firmer (Nikkei +0.86%) and US futures are up after Thanksgiving, but Brent near $92-97 on Middle East shipping disruption and a weaker rupee (92.44) are the drag. Europe rose on Thursday as the latest US tariff proposals were judged less severe than feared.

points.text: GIFT Nifty 25,989 at 7:44 am, down 43 points; Business Standard had futures 69 points lower at 25,958.
Nikkei 225 +0.86% to 57,499; FTSE 100 +1.75% and CAC 40 +1.61% on Thursday; US cash markets closed for Thanksgiving, US futures higher this morning (S&P 500 +1.4% at 8:09 am).
Brent settled $96.57 (+$1.96) on Thursday on fresh Middle East shipping disruption; rupee provisionally 92.44 per dollar, down 24 paise.
FIIs bought a net Rs 4,479 Cr on Wednesday 25 Nov; Thursday's provisional flows were not yet reported in the sources read.

market.watch: Crude above $95 and the rupee past 92.5 are the risks; US is a short session tonight (closes 11:30 pm IST).
